hnsw.note: VLite HnswConfig defaults, applied explicitly to every engine exposing them

metric: squared L2 / Euclidean; recall is ID-based and tie-aware against a float64 oracle
latency: sequential, one client thread, one query in flight; QPS = queries / sum(latency)

durability.vlite-server: Every successful write (each /v1/batches request) is synced before 204 (default).
durability.qdrant: Defaults: WAL appended per request (wait=true waits for apply); WAL and segments are flushed periodically (flush_interval_sec=5), not fsynced per request.
durability.qdrant-grpc: Same server defaults as qdrant (gRPC transport only differs).
durability.pgvector: PostgreSQL defaults fsync=on, synchronous_commit=on: WAL fsynced at each batch transaction commit.
